title: Noise operator evaluation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ho\in[-1,1]$, let $f$ be a bounded real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $x$ be a point of that cube. Applying the noise operator with parameter $ho$ to $f$ and evaluating at $x$ gives the noise-kernel expectation of $f$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a real-valued function on the n-dimensional sign cube
x is in the n-dimensional sign cube
